newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber firmer at close on Tokyo's gains.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber firmer at close on Tokyo's gains.

text.p: The Malaysian rubber market closed higher with a firmer close in Tokyo and scattered enquiries from Europe pushing up prices, dealers said.
"The rise was aided by higher Tokyo prices. Otherwise the market was inactive with only scattered enquiries from Europe for latex and SMR nearbys," a dealer at a trading firm said.
Europeans dealers were seen covering their positions or building up their stocks ahead of the summer holidays.
The Asian countries were inactive while waiting for cheaper prices. "Thai prices are high due to its government intervention and we expect buyers to step in here, " a trader said."
Traders quoted SMR CV at 331 cents, SMR L at 309, SMR 10 at 263 and drum latex at 228.
"Production is seen high and we have a surplus of raw materials at least for the near-term," dealer said.
The INRO five-day moving average was Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg was 213.60 on May 28 against 213.19 on May 27. The daily indicator price was 214.83 against 214.86.
